analysis.focal_family: Three pairwise strategy contrasts on 467 main English type texts; two-sided paired percentile bootstrap, Bonferroni family confidence 1-0.05/3 per contrast.
analysis.historical: Original small-KB strategy results and completed core hybrid runs are historical/descriptive context, not extra repeats in this primary comparison.
analysis.interpretation: A predeclared post-selection DEV extension, not untouched confirmation or an automatic change of the main hybrid configuration. No single-bucket, MMR-only, fusion-only or pure ranking attribution.
analysis.other_endpoints: Same three contrasts per remaining roster, descriptive pointwise 95% intervals. Separate 103-text sensitivity; no pooled overall F1 or outcome-selected endpoint.
analysis.scoring: Inherit fixed full-roster support>=10 labels, strict gate, missing vs empty rules and mean-of-three-run F1. All pairwise contrasts on an endpoint share the mask valid in all nine strategy/repeat settings. Keep every null and invalid-inclusive bounds; no favourable resampling.

Per subset/strategy delivered counts, shortfalls, annotation/source/language/label mix, overlap and pairwise example-vector redundancy. No gold-based retuning.

implementation_qualifications: Budgets are maxima 2 definitions, 2 guidelines, 5 examples, zero feedback. BM25 retains positive-score-only behavior, may underfill and has no padding/fallback.

Existing dense examples: 15 ANN candidates, MMR to 5. Existing hybrid: 30 ANN candidates, MMR to 10, BM25 depth 10, RRF k=60 to 5. Abstract dense depth 2 versus hybrid channel depth 10. These are strategy-package differences, not just adding a lexical channel.
use_mmr=true applies to the dense example path, not BM25-only or abstract records. Keep source behavior unchanged.
